title: Diablo 2 Inspired ARPG - UPDATE DAY 4 [New zone, Boss fight]
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hi everyone,

Promised to post an update on my D2 inspired ARPG game I'm building with my engine, this whole build is made using only Tesana AI - which generates everything for me as I'm prompting it with natural language 

I've added some more stuff to the game:  
\- Treasure chests  
\- Portals to the village, and more areas  
\- Village zone  
\- Village NPC's with quests  
\- Boss fight

  
Next up is adding a new Wizard class and a new zone, I'm thinking a spider zone - but open to ideas!   
  
I'm also thinking about doing a tutorial how this was made

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: the engine does it for me

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: the engine generated the sprite sheet of the guy with the sword? there's no way..

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: yessir! you can take the game and branch out your own build if you want with the remix feature

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: Explain to me what generated the sprite sheet means? Like did it just download free graphics off the internet? Because I promise you claude code didn't generate all those assets

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: It's a 3d model generated by the engine, with full animations - I only configured the sword in the hand and the AI handled the rest

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: Can you please ask your AI to explain to you how it was created? I've literally never seen an AI able to just generate 3d models and animate them.
